reference.seq_vs_pow_note: Sequential binary64 multiplication by 0.9 need not be bit-identical to math.pow; explicit tolerance is 16 ulps.
reference.source: Independent known references: exact dyadic products 0.5**10 and 2**10; math.exp(0)==1; Decimal(-1).exp() inside the Leibniz enclosure of exp(-1). Sequential 0.9 multiplies compared to pow with an explicit 16-ulp binary64 rounding tolerance. math.exp(-1) compared to the series enclosure with an explicit 1-ulp tolerance.
